name: citation-entailment-v1
license: synthetic, CC0 — hand-written examples, no external corpus
description: Labeled claim/evidence set for the entailment assessor. Each item is a claim, a list of evidence passages, an expected structured label (supports/contradicts/insufficient), and a `kind`: `obvious` (label recoverable by lexical overlap), `hard_paraphrase` (the entailing/contradicting passage restates the claim with different words and — for contradictions — no explicit negation cue, so token-overlap assessors miss it and a semantic/NLI assessor is required), or `mixed` (multiple passages, some irrelevant or conflicting, exercising claim-specific retrieval and contradiction dominance). Synthetic and legally shareable; NOT Google's private set. Human audit and threshold selection remain an external gap (no annotator panel).
